resources.string: This card is closed; no further visits can be recorded.
Are you sure? This client’s card will close and leave the service recipients list.
Child confirmed HIV-positive — no longer eligible
The mother’s card will close as deceased. Her household closes only if no live child and no other eligible mother remains.
The mother’s card will close because she moved from the area. A recorded receiving facility is retained for transfer.
The mother’s card will close as transferred to the recorded facility.
Three consecutive Not found — Other visits close this card. The recorded reason is retained.
The mother’s card will close after the recorded pregnancy loss.
The mother’s card will close after the recorded stillbirth.
The mother’s card will close for the recorded pregnancy outcome. The Other explanation is retained.
The child has died. The mother’s card and any linked EID follow-up close. The household closes if no other eligible mother remains.
The child has a confirmed HIV-positive result. The mother is no longer eligible; confirm the child’s CTC linkage.
The child’s final 18-month test is negative. The mother graduates and any linked EID follow-up closes.
